FAQ

What products are available for purchase on Midasbuy, and how does it compare to the in-game store?
Midasbuy is Tencent’s officially designated overseas top-up platform for games and entertainment content, mainly providing global players with services for purchasing in-game virtual currency, passes, and items. Compared with in-game stores, Midasbuy often offers better-value top-up experiences through exclusive promotions, bonus UC, and VIP-only benefits, while also supporting a wider range of local payment methods. As an official top-up store, it provides instant crediting and reliable after-sales support, making it easy for you to complete purchases conveniently and enjoy more benefits. For details, please visit the Midasbuy Official Top-Up Center.
Is Midasbuy the official top-up store for PUBG Mobile?
Yes, Midasbuy is the only officially authorized top-up store for PUBG Mobile. You can purchase UC and other items with confidence. Using Midasbuy ensures your transactions are secure and protects your account information, as it is fully integrated with PUBG Mobile’s official system. Players often choose it precisely because of its official security, as well as the exclusive promotions and bonus rewards offered by the platform, which may not be available through other channels. You can find the verified PUBG Mobile top-up page at the Midasbuy Official Top-Up Center.
What is the official top-up store for PUBGM?
The only official top-up store for PUBG Mobile is Midasbuy. As Tencent’s official global top-up platform, it provides players with a safe, direct channel to purchase UC and in-game items. You can also find exclusive offers and local payment methods for your region on the official Midasbuy website.
Midasbuy offers many more price tiers than the in-game store; is it safe to make purchases there?
Yes, Midasbuy offers more than 13 top-up tiers for players to choose from. Midasbuy is the official top-up store for PUBGM, offering exclusive discounts and extra UC rewards, with instant delivery and guaranteed after-sales support. Please top up with confidence.
Where can I get a discount on a PUBG Mobile subscription?
If you’re looking for discounts on PUBG Mobile subscription services, such as Prime or Prime Plus, the most reliable option is the official top-up partner Midasbuy. As a Tencent-authorized platform, Midasbuy regularly offers regional promotions, including website-exclusive prices, value bundles, and discounts on subscription plans, which may be better deals than purchasing directly in the app. You can visit the website, select your region, enter your Player ID, and then browse the subscription section to view the latest offers. Another effective way to save money is to choose a long-term subscription plan, such as a 3-month, 6-month, or 12-month package, which can usually help reduce the average monthly cost.
